about.story.title: Our story
about.p1_html: Go Drive is a mobile app. One app to send a parcel, call an ambulance or get roadside assistance — straight from your phone.
about.p2_html: Our mission: make access to mobility services as simple as sending a message. No queues. No phone calls. No paperwork. You open the app, you post your request — that’s it.
about.p3_html: Every order is tracked in real time, shared through a secure QR code, and confirmed at every step with a push notification. Everything you need fits in your pocket.
about.mission.v1.title: Simplicity
about.mission.v1.text: An intuitive app, ready in seconds.
about.mission.v2.title: Speed
about.mission.v2.text: Drivers, ambulances and roadside help in real time.
about.mission.v3.title: Trust
about.mission.v3.text: Tracking, notifications and a secure QR for every order.
